name: v1.3.0 - session time, popup, gaming-first, artwork fallback
body:
## New in v1.3.0

- **Session time**: elapsed play time per player from gaming_status `play_start_time`, with auto-discovery of matching `sensor.gaming_status_*` sensors (or explicit `session_entities` per user)
- **Player details popup**: click a player (default `click_action: popup`) for platform status, game, session time, voice info, and last-online
- **Gamers-first layout**: players currently in a game sort ahead of non-gamers
- **Artwork fallback**: new `image_source` option — `auto` (default) prefers native Discord/Xbox/Steam art, derives Steam hero from `game_id`, and uses gaming_status local cache as backup; `standard` skips gaming_status entirely
- **Works fully without gaming_status installed**
- **Voice icons**: `inline` is now the default position (directly after name, closer spacing); `overlay` still available
- **Stable generated Steam image URLs** for browser caching
- Xbox support (from v1.2.0), platform-badge fix (v1.2.1), and ha-panel-lovelace guard (v1.1.4) all included

### Options added

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `image_source` | `auto` | `auto` = native art first + gaming_status backup; `standard` = never use gaming_status |
| `session_entities` (per user) | — | Pin gaming_status sensors for session time |

### Example

```yaml
type: custom:unified-gaming-card
title: "Gaming"
image_source: auto
users:
  - name: "Player 1"
    discord: sensor.discord_user_123456789
    steam: sensor.steam_player_1
    session_entities:
      - sensor.gaming_status_player_1_steam
```
